**Verdict: PASS** for DG1 round 16 (task T-DG1-REV-QA-R16) on candidate `sha256:56f3eb885c6cf3db406e280d232e48ebcefddad173107a744bb9b8ca74fc2b4c`. The candidate ID recomputes identically in the repo and in a disposable clone, and the freeze commit `aa7d9a8` only adds metadata on top of base `13418b8`.

**Findings closed (both Low, same cause):**

| Finding | Raised by | Result |
|---|---|---|
| F-DG1-218 | qa-verifier, round 15 | CLOSED_VERIFIED |
| F-DG1-137 | code-security-reviewer, round 15 | CLOSED_VERIFIED |

- **The fix works.** I wrote my own test covering 125 file names, 112 of which the lint actually scans. For every name, the new check agrees with TypeScript's own declaration-file classification (public and internal). Nothing crashes, and a real syntax error always gives a named `unparseable source` message, never `Debug Failure`. It passed 246/246 on Node 22 and Node 24.
- **The tests catch the bug.** I put the round-15 regex back in the clone only. The 2 new checks and 11 of my cases then failed with the original `Debug Failure`.
- **Test-only change.** Only `architecture.testkit.ts` and `architecture.test.ts` changed. `vitest.config.ts` is untouched, and the testkit is not part of the runtime build.

**Earlier fixes still hold:**
- **F-DG1-009 / F-DG1-136:** integration passed 200/200 in four runs on a disposable PostgreSQL 16.13: Node 22 twice, Node 24 once, and Node 22 under full CPU load. There were no 57P01 connection errors and no "Hook timed out".
- **F-DG1-210:** the business-unit Lead journey (Edit/Archive without reload) passed in English and Arabic on both Node versions.
- **F-DG1-214:** unit-web passed 110/110 on Node 24.
- **F-DG1-217:** its own checks are still green.

**Regression checks:**
- Build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint (33 operations), no-CDN, formatting and contrast checks are all clean.
- Unit tests passed 325/325 on both Node versions, with the architecture tests at 132/132.
- Migrations 0001–0008 apply. The audit table rejects UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE, and the contract test covers `getBrandingTokens`.
- End-to-end tests passed 22/22 in English and Arabic on both Node versions, with no accessibility violations. I looked at the Arabic screenshot: it renders right-to-left correctly.
- Acceptance suites A12, A13, A14, A18 and A20 all pass.
- `validate.mjs --register DG1`, `--pipeline` and `--reconcile` all pass.
- All 12 requirements are IMPLEMENTED for DG1, and none of their evidence files is missing.

**New findings:** none.

**Observation (not a finding):** under Node 24, the Playwright reporter prints wrong line numbers, for example line 482 in a 443-line file. Round 15 shows the same pattern and the source was unchanged, so this is a tooling display issue with no product impact.

**BLOCKED:** I could not re-run the REQ-DLV-042 installer's live download because the sandbox has no registry network access. That requirement rests on the orchestrator's acceptance log, which is unchanged since round 15 (14 pass, 0 fail).

**Independence:** I wrote no implementation and did not read any other reviewer's round-16 record. During my run, HEAD moved to `925a48b` through the runner's auto-commit of the domain-reviewer run; I saw only its directory names, and the candidate ID did not change. I ran all code in a disposable clone and removed it afterwards. The record passes the review schema, and all 82 evidence paths exist.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG1/round-16/qa-verifier.json` (review record)
- `reviews/DG1/round-16/qa-verifier.verifications.json` (closes the two findings)
- `reviews/DG1/round-16/qa-verifier.md` (narrative)
- `test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-16/` (logs and screenshots)
- `test-evidence/DG1/qa/tests/round-16/qa-r16-declaration-file-probe.test.ts` (my test)
